keeps: all thresholds of lab/out/nucleo1s_prereg.json, nucleo1s_3d_prereg.json, nucleo1s_3d_amend1.json unchanged

learn2.U: weighted mean of the highest lines of results['scan_bare_0.5'] until their weight sum >= 0.4 (the nucleus-blind pair)
learn2.objective: std^2 + (centroid - U)^2 of the 1s lines of the Laboratorio start state (weight >= 0.03, omega in [0.80, 0.95])

scan.note: same machinery as the phase-2 scans (part_scan)

knobs: 2 numbers (s0, s1), same as phase 2; U is not a knob (it is read from the bare rule)

M1.what: learning: at a = 0.5 the best point has 1s spread (max - min of lines) <= 0.002 mc^2 AND |centroid - U| <= 5e-4 mc^2 (both internal criteria met together)

M2.what: MAIN EXAM: with the same 2 numbers, at a = 0.4, 0.3, 0.24, 0.2 the 1s centroid binding is within 1 % of Dirac (omega 0.899052, binding 0.100948) AND the spread is <= 0.002 mc^2 (a = 0.5 reported, not judged: it is the training lattice)

M3.what: the Laboratorio beat is closed: at a = 0.5 the spread of the learned2 1s is <= 1/10 of the bare Laboratorio spread (0.0196)

M4.what: excited states not worse: at a = 0.4 (box 32) with learned2, the mean |binding error| of 2s, 2p1/2, 2p3/2 is <= that of the bare nucleus (same rule as E1)

M5.what: cost: if M2 passes, cells for the 1s within 1 % with learned2 at the coarsest passing a vs bare uniform (6.1e6 cells, phase 2): ratio >= 10
